matchups.update: Rob's absolutely flexing right now with a 32-point lead, but don't get too comfortable—that's basically Christian McCaffrey putting up a dud that could've buried a normal team; imagine if he'd actually shown up. Meanwhile Rilind is still waiting for someone, anyone, to catch a fucking ball, sitting at a goose egg like he's actively sabotaging his own week. This is less "close game" and more "Rob's cruising while Rilind watches the waiver wire in real-time panic mode."

Adam's got a razor-thin lead but Drake Maye is actively sabotaging his chances—that's nearly 11 points left on the table right there. Jetmir and Peter are hanging around in striking distance, which means Adam's basically got one hand tied behind his back waiting for Maye to remember he's a fucking quarterback. This is still anyone's game, but Adam's letting his QB gift-wrap a loss he doesn't deserve.

Rinor's getting absolutely **demolished** right now and it's almost entirely self-inflicted -- Davante Adams is putting up historically bad numbers when you needed him to actually show up, and meanwhile Ilir's coasting on a Seahawks defense that remembered how to tackle this week. Down 10 with most of the slate still to play, Rinor's gonna need Adams to shake whatever the hell is going on and a miracle from his bench, because this is the kind of deficit that gets you panic-trading by Thursday.

Flamur's got a whole touchdown lead and all they've got to show for it is a measly 7 points—which tells you everything you need to know about how fucking catastrophic this week has been for both of you. Faton's sitting at a goose egg like they forgot they were even in this league, while Flamur's barely limping along with whatever scraps they could pull off. This is less of a matchup and more of a mutual suicide pact, but hey, at least one of you is winning something right now.

Veton's getting absolutely demolished right now, and the worst part is Mike Evans is basically carrying the entire team on his back just to make this look respectable—dude's literally the only reason this isn't a complete bloodbath. Meanwhile Arben's over here with Jaxon Smith-Njigba running a fucking clinic, outpacing his own average like he actually knows how to field a competent roster for once. If Veton doesn't get some serious production from the bench, this turns into a full-on mercy killing by Sunday.

Ben's got a whole 9.9 points and he's acting like he's winning the Super Bowl, but that's only because Nori decided to field a fucking ghost this week—literally zero points is a choice. The real problem? Puka Nacua showed up to get paid and left at halftime, dropping nearly 10 points below his average like he had money on Ben losing. Ben's still got time to blow this, but right now Nori's got to pray his bench wakes up because this is actively embarrassing.
